st-0mhZ.title: Pole: wooden, blue bottom, 'CST'
st-0mhZ.summary: Some wooden poles are painted blue at the bottom and have the letters CST written on them.

st-1MAM.title: Taxis: bright yellow
st-1MAM.summary: Taxis and minibuses are painted bright yellow.

st-1vUE.title: Plants: oil palm plantations
st-1vUE.summary: In the south of São Tomé you can find large oil palm plantations.

st-5C59.title: Pole: red and white painted
st-5C59.summary: The town of Trinidade has poles painted red and white.

st-5DnQ.title: Google car: black car, black roof rails
st-5DnQ.summary: On São Tomé, the bigger island, the Google car is black with black roof rails. It is usually blurred out.

st-8u6S.title: Pole: ladder pole, Portugal-style signs
st-8u6S.summary: Ladder-style utility poles and pedestrian signs have the same design as in Portugal, so they look identical to Portuguese ones.

st-EmV2.title: Language: Portuguese
st-EmV2.summary: Portuguese is the main language on signs and shops. It narrows the guess to Portuguese-speaking countries.

st-Iix7.title: Landscape: tropical rainforest, bananas
st-Iix7.summary: Tropical islands almost fully covered in rainforest, with banana plants everywhere along the roads.

st-YviS.title: Google car: blue roof, silver roof rails
st-YviS.summary: On Príncipe the Google car has a blue roof and silver roof rails. It can sometimes be blurred out.

st-ij58.title: Google car: slanted antenna on the side
st-ij58.summary: In many places a slanted antenna sticks out from the side of the Google car.

st-mteu.title: Coverage: dim, hazy low-quality camera
st-mteu.summary: Very low-quality footage with a huge blur over the back of the car and a smaller blur at the front. It is dimmer and hazier than the similar camera in India and Nigeria.

differs.how: India's version is sharper and brighter
Nigeria's version is sharper and brighter

st-oaFS.title: Coverage: extra dim, faded colours
st-oaFS.summary: An even dimmer, more washed-out version of the low-quality camera. It is most common on Príncipe, the smaller northern island.
